Rose Bike Women's MTB Ride

Orono, ME · Mountain bike

Women / trans / femmeNo-drop

Rose Bike Women's MTB Ride is a mountain bike group ride in Orono, ME. It rolls every Wednesday at 5:00 pm from Rose Bike (sometimes meets at other local trails). Pace: intermediate, no-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: intermediate, no-drop. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @rosebikeshop the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Rose Bike Women's MTB Ride group ride

A Wednesday women's mountain bike ride from the shop in downtown Orono. All Rose Bike rides are no-drop. The shop also runs a Monday MTB ride, a Tuesday beginner MTB ride from Old Town Elementary, a mellow Tuesday mixed-surface ride and a Saturday MTB ride. Helmet and yearly waiver required.
